prompt: Wide landscape 3:2 full bleed fine-art illustrated postcard, entirely without lettering, without border, no typography or symbols that resemble writing. A small and very earnest calico cat acting as a night postal courier, its mouth carefully holding the corner of a single sealed antique rose envelope with a cream star sticker, sitting in the open sash of a printmaker's softly lit window. Indigo blue night with a little golden crescent moon and scattered stars outside, warm apricot light from the room falls across one paw, a few dark leaves framing the edge. Place the cat centered just left of middle. A charming silhouette and gentle expression, anatomically correct, only the natural visible front paws. Hand-drawn midcentury children's book gouache and lithograph on toothy paper, deep indigo, terracotta, dusty cream, muted lavender shadow. Remarkable tender composition, confident sweeps of color, gorgeous handprinted grain and painterly marks, no gradient or shiny computer-rendered effect, an original piece of art an illustrator would send to a friend. No words, no fake lettering, no caption, no graphic frame.
